[RFCS.9.3] Immediately following a `Checkpoint` atom the encoder MUST
emit: for every schema with live facts — one `SchemaDef` and its `Slot`
atoms (even if already announced earlier in the file), then one
`FactAssert` atom per currently-live fact.  These re-emitted `FactAssert` atoms
use the original `clock_ns` of each assertion ([RFCS.8.3]) and
fresh `fact_id` values valid only within the segment that begins at
this checkpoint.
